int ff[maxn][maxn], gg[maxn][maxn];

            temp = mul (add (mul (g[j], f[i - 1 - j]), mul (g[i - 1 - j], f[j])), i + 1);
            g[i] = add (g[i], mul (temp, C(i - 1, j)));
        }
    }
    ff[0][0] = 1; gg[0][0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++)
        {
            if (!ff[i][j]) continue;
            for (int k = 1; k + j <= m; k++)
            {
                ff[i + 1][j + k] = add (ff[i + 1][j + k], mul (mul (ff[i][j], f[k]), C(j + k, k)));
                gg[i + 1][j + k] = add (gg[i + 1][j + k], mul (add (mul (gg[i][j], f[k]), mul (ff[i][j], g[k])), C(j + k, k)));
            }
        }
